name: player_restore_recorded_node_flags
description: Player::RestoreRecordedNodeFlags walks the recorded node-flag restore vector and re-enables the saved cell-pickable, raycastable, and pickable flags.
known_limits: Tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage focuses on caller-visible node-flag restore behavior through the natural std::vector<PlayerNodeFlagRestoreEntry> interface.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and HLIL for 0x41efa0 validate 16-byte restore-entry iteration, node pointer at offset 0, saved cell-pickable/raycastable/pickable flags at offsets 4/8/12, and calls to gwNodeSetCellPickable, gwNodeSetRaycastable, and gwNodeSetPickable with value 1 only when the corresponding saved flag is nonzero.

The native smoke populates and inspects the natural vector through clear, push_back, size, and operator[] and verifies empty-preserving and mixed-entry behavior: no saved flags leave a node unchanged, all saved flags restore bits 0x38, and a raycast-only restore does not enable unrelated cell-pickable state.
